title: QCLI-227 follow-up: claude-target block told CI to run the codex-target check
description: Found by opum-agent while verifying QCLI-230/OPAG-38 on origin/dev: the managed quest:agent-instructions block QCLI-227 writes under --target claude still said 'CI should run quest agents --check --require-installed' with no --target, because questAgentInstructions was a single hardcoded template shared by both targets (src/application/agents/agent-instructions.ts:26-30 pre-fix). A CI job that followed the CLAUDE.md block's own instruction verbatim would check AGENTS.md, find nothing, and fail - the exact failure QCLI-227 exists to fix. The version pin (also in that sentence) is QCLI-228's separate, already-filed problem.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The block written for --target claude tells its reader to run --check --require-installed --target claude; the block written for the default/codex target is unchanged (no --target mentioned), verified byte-for-byte against the pre-fix constant
Tests cover both: the claude-target block contains the --target claude hint, and the codex-target/default block does not regress to mentioning --target at all

checkQuestAgentInstructions/applyQuestAgentInstructions/updateQuestAgentInstructions/inspectQuestAgentInstructions all take the target consistently so a check against a block written for one target cannot silently compare against the others text

implementationNotes: Made questAgentInstructions a target-parameterized function (questAgentInstructionsFor), keeping the exported questAgentInstructions constant byte-identical (codex default) for existing callers. Threaded target through checkQuestAgentInstructions/applyQuestAgentInstructions/updateQuestAgentInstructions/inspectQuestAgentInstructions and both CLI call sites in main.ts (init --agent-instructions, agents --check/--update-instructions). New assertions: bootstrap-process.test.ts's CLAUDE.md-target test now checks the written block literally contains 'quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude'; the existing default-target test now asserts AGENTS.md's block contains the untargeted hint and does NOT contain the string --target at all. Full bun run check green: 403/403 tests, typecheck, lint (2 pre-existing unrelated warnings), format, layer boundaries.
finalSummary: Fixed the gap opum-agent found while verifying QCLI-230: the managed block's own CI-hint sentence now names the exact --target it needs (claude gets '--target claude', codex/default stays untargeted, unchanged from before QCLI-227). Verified with new test assertions on both targets and the full check suite.
